scope: Registered internal API offline guards and owned real-stack journeys; not complete domain migration or release qualification

foundation.purpose: Offline contract and generated type checks only
unitTests: generates deterministic required, enum and nullable types that reject invalid consumers
rejects unsupported query encodings including referenced parameters
normalizes only ordering and runtime origins without changing schema semantics
rejects empty, duplicate, dangling and missing-path-parameter contracts
does not normalize away field, required, enum, nullability, security or operation drift
explicit selection preserves recursive schemas and denies missing or repeated operations
external references fail closed instead of reading arbitrary remote contracts
resolves imported aliases, local constants, class base URLs and encoded templates
matches fixed routes preferentially and does not guess fixed paths from client variables
retains missing, external and indirect calls rather than silently excluding them
counts generated operations without mistaking request headers or request caches for HTTP calls
fails closed on unexpected endpoints, HTTP failures, invalid JSON and empty catalogs
requires a fresh receipt and never writes success when the live catalog drifts
foundation audit rejects empty missing repeated skipped failed and unexpected test evidence
foundation audit accepts each registered passing test exactly once
CLI entrypoints reject missing arguments when invoked through a symlink
captured drift compares semantic contracts and refuses receipt reuse
captured drift never creates success evidence for an empty or changed producer document
response shape validates nested references required fields nullability arrays and scalar types
response shape refuses undeclared operations statuses media and validates error response references
response shape detects stale nullable metadata without claiming format or business acceptance
generates binary multipart fields as Blob while preserving nullable parts
source graph follows router resources and workspace exports while retaining type-only candidates
source graph keeps missing imports dynamic modules and indirect route files unresolved
source graph respects package export boundaries and rejects ambiguous source identities
core release projection permits product additions but rejects core schema parameter and security drift
enumerates finite route branches and retains every missing external or unbounded alternative
retains aliased bound and injected network transports without marking shadowed generated calls migrated
keeps replaceable route defaults and mutable bases outside proven source links
browser catalog reconciles independent spec tests scenes and mandatory JSON evidence
browser catalog rejects missing empty skipped shadowed dynamic duplicated or unregistered evidence
browser evidence separates functional execution from exact original review and source runtime identity
browser evidence rejects stale failed skipped retried missing mismatched or unreviewed attempts

dictionary.purpose: Dictionary JSON operation browser regression; not full migration acceptance
tests: generated dictionary operations preserve the UI journey
anonymous dictionary navigation and API access are refused
generated dictionary data supplies labels to the real DSL team list
dictionary batch feedback uses actual counts and an empty tree remains editable

dictionaryWire.purpose: Real dictionary response structures and listed business invariants; API driver, not UI or full format acceptance
tests: all registered dictionary operations satisfy their real JSON response structures

profile.purpose: Owned username-only profile and avatar journey with existing password policy; not all authorization or tenant coverage
tests: generated profile operations persist an owned avatar and no-email profile
generated profile operations preserve an email-only account without a username

savedViewWire.purpose: Real owned-account SavedView operation responses and listed persistence/negative invariants; API driver, not UI or complete tenant acceptance
tests: generated SavedView operations preserve owned configuration and public sharing boundaries

savedView.purpose: Owned global-view sharing through the real management panel and anonymous configuration/password/error UI; not all SavedView CRUD or tenant acceptance
tests: generated SavedView sharing preserves the owner and anonymous browser journeys

sessionCompatibility.purpose: Real browser compatibility regression exposed by the internal API gate; not full auth or dashboard migration acceptance
tests: dashboard usage and account logout survive missing randomUUID

teamsWire.purpose: Nine real team REST operations, nullable fields, owned membership transitions and anonymous refusal; not browser, role or tenant acceptance
tests: generated team operations preserve owned memberships and nullable response fields

teams.purpose: Owned team member UI journey through the registered DSL menu; not all organization or authorization coverage
tests: generated team memberships preserve the menu add reload and remove journey
team viewer reads the real menu while viewer and unassigned writes are forbidden

dslRendererGate.purpose: Fixed static renderer gate fixtures; not API or UI behavior acceptance
unitTests: reads actual registry calls instead of comments or string lookalikes
allows implemented status pills only on direct table columns
removing a real table renderer branch makes its page fail
unknown renderers still fail in table blocks and nested pages
comments strings and non-rendering conditions cannot declare table capabilities
empty and malformed page inputs fail without producing a green gate

memberSearchWire.purpose: Tenant scoped member search structure, public identities and nullable email-only username; not cross-tenant acceptance
tests: generated tenant member search preserves scoped public identities and email-only null usernames

sessionsWire.purpose: Own active session metadata and exact current/specific/all revocation; API-driven, not security page browser acceptance
tests: generated session operations revoke only owned sessions and preserve other users
